blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Automatically extracted narrative networks — graphs with entities as nodes and their relations as edges — have proven useful for revealing central narrative structures through salient entities and their connections [ 16 , 10 ] . But a narrative is more than those central structures that everything else revolves around. This work is concerned with the everything else : brief sub-plots, small clusters of descriptions, or associations between minor characters that go under the radar at the macro-level. We present an approach to unearth such peripheral structures. They involve rare entities with limited textual presence, overshadowed by dominant entities and lost among each other in the long tail of many but rare entities [ 1 ] . We leverage the known tendency of pointwise mutual information [ 4 ] to inflate for rare events, turning its weakness into a strength by weighting edges with PMI to foreground peripheral entity configurations. Communities extracted from the resulting network are structural traces of underlying narrative elements. We demonstrate the approach on The Lord of the Rings . From measures of how concentrated or dispersed a community’s activations are across the text, a typology emerges that reveals that peripheral structures form more than a single class: episodic passages, echoing long-distance connections, and recurring threads each surface as distinct configurations. The approach is conceptually simple and surfaces fine-grained narrative details that are lost in abundance, though its deliberate amplification of weak signals comes with inherent sensitivity — best understood as a lens for exploration rather than a robust extraction pipeline.
blocks.zh: 事实证明,自动提取的叙事网络——以实体为节点的图表及其边缘关系——有助于通过突出实体及其联系揭示中央叙事结构[16,10]. 但叙述比其他一切围绕着的中心结构还要多。 这部作品关注其他一切:短小的子平面,小的描述集群,或者小人物之间的关联,在宏观层面会进入雷达下. 我们提出了挖掘这种外围结构的办法。 它们涉及文字存在有限的稀有实体,被主导实体所掩盖并在许多但稀有实体的长尾巴中相互丢失[1]. 我们利用已知的指向相互信息[4]的倾向,为罕见事件增高,通过加重边与PMI来将它的弱点转化为力量来预测外围实体的配置. 从由此产生的网络中取出的社区是基本叙述要素的结构痕迹。 我们向魔戒之王展示方法 从一个社区的激活如何集中或分散到整个文本中,出现了一种类型,它揭示了外围结构构成的不止一个类别:零星的通道、与长途连接相呼应的线条,以及每个表面作为不同构型的反复出现。 这种方法在概念上简单而表面细微的叙述性细节在丰富多彩中丢失了,尽管它有意地放大弱信号带有内在的敏感性——最好被理解为勘探的透镜,而不是活泼的取出管道.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Automatically extracted narrative networks — graphs with entities as nodes and their relations as edges — reflect structures of a narrative [ 7 , 16 , 10 ] . Such networks have proven particularly useful in foregrounding central narrative structures of salient entities and their connections at a macro-level, typically by highlighting salient entities and their interactions through frequency-based or centrality-based measures.
blocks.zh: 自动提取的叙事网络——以实体为节点的图表及其边缘关系——反映了叙事的结构[7,16,10]. 事实证明,这种网络特别有助于在宏观一级确定重要实体及其联系的中央叙事结构,典型的做法是通过基于频率或以中心为主的衡量来突出突出重要实体及其相互作用。

blocks.en: However, such approaches tend to emphasize dominant elements of a narrative while providing limited access to less frequent or more localized configurations. Narratives contain a wide range of such configurations, including brief descriptive passages, minor interactions, and associations among infrequent entities. According to Zipf’s law, the distribution of words or entities extracted from a corpus has a long tail of rare ones. On one hand, such rare entities are easily overshadowed by more salient entities. On the other hand, they are lost among each other in the long tail of many but rare entities [ 1 ] along with noise from extraction errors. They form a seemingly unstructured mass, yet there is structure to be recovered in how entities belong together in few but specific configurations. As such, the problem is not about needles in a haystack, but about how the straws of the haystack fit together.
blocks.zh: 然而,这类办法往往强调说明中的主要要素,同时提供较少或更本地化的配置。 叙述部分包含广泛的此类配置,包括简短的描述性段落、小互动和不常见实体之间的关联。 根据Zipf的法律,从一个实体中提取的文字或实体的分布有很长的稀有尾巴. 一方面,这种罕见的实体很容易被更突出的实体所掩盖。 另一方面,它们在许多但稀有实体的长尾巴上相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相 它们形成一个似乎没有结构的质地,然而,在实体如何以很少但具体的组合组合组合在一起方面,存在着需要恢复的结构. 因此,问题不在于干草堆的针头,而在于干草堆的稻草如何相接.

blocks.en: To recover this structure, we propose using pointwise mutual information [ 4 ] , which has a known tendency to inflate for rare entities. Here, we turn its weakness to a strength. We leverage the inflation to foreground these structures by weighting edges with PMI and extracting communities from a network that thereby favors the rarities. The amplification of weak signals comes with inherent sensitivity — a property we return to in the discussion. The extracted communities represent very different parts of a narrative – who’s, what’s, where’s, when’s and why’s [ 14 ] – and can be considered structural traces of peripheral narrative elements. Whether eventful, descriptive or even lyrical, they pertain to the size, shape, and composition of smaller parts of narrative that computational studies can reveal [ 15 ] . As molecules of a larger narrative structure, they contribute texture and specificity to the whole.
blocks.zh: 为了恢复这种结构,我们提议采用点心的相互信息[4],这种信息有为稀有实体充气的已知趋势。 在这里,我们将其弱点转化为力量。 我们利用通货膨胀来预测这些结构, 利用PMI的分量, 将社区从网络中抽取出来, 从而有利于稀有。 微弱信号的放大带有内在的敏感性——我们在讨论中再次谈到这一财产。 被摘取的社区代表着叙述的非常不同的部分 — — 谁是、是什么、在哪里、何时和为什么[14] — — 并且可以被认为是边缘叙述要素的结构痕迹。 无论是事件性,描述性,还是甚至语言性,它们都与计算研究能够揭示的叙述中较小部分的大小,形状和构成有关. [15]. 作为较大的叙事结构的分子,它们为整体贡献出纹理和特异性.

blocks.en: We demonstrate the approach on The Lord of the Rings trilogy as a complex narrative work whose richness in sub-plots, world-building, and peripheral narrative elements makes it a suitable test case for the extraction of peripheral structures. No benchmark exists for our task and the approach is at an exploratory stage. Evaluation is therefore qualitative: we examine whether extracted communities correspond to recognizable structures in the source text.
blocks.zh: 我们把环王三部曲作为复杂的叙事作品展现出来,其丰富多彩的分板,世界建设,和外围叙事元素使它成为取出外围结构的合适试验案例. 我们的任务没有基准,方法正处于探索阶段。 因此,评价是定性的:我们审查抽取的社区是否与来源文本中可识别的结构相符。

blocks.en: The contribution of this paper is twofold. Methodologically, it demonstrates how PMI weighting can be used to systematically foreground low-frequency co-occurrences in narrative networks and how community detection can organize these into analyzable structures. Analytically, it provides an initial characterization of variation among such structures based on their distribution across a text. The approach is intended as a complement to existing methods that focus on salient entities, offering a means of exploring structure in the long tail rather than replacing established techniques.
blocks.zh: 本文件的贡献是双重的。 从方法上讲,它表明如何利用PMI加权来系统地预测叙述网络中的低频共发现象,以及社区探测如何将这些现象组织成可分析的结构。 从分析上看,它根据这些结构在案文中的分布情况,对这些结构之间的差异作了初步描述。 这种办法旨在补充以突出实体为重点的现有方法,为探索长尾的结构而不是取代已确立的技术提供了手段。

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: Narrative graphs model a text as a network where nodes represent entities mentioned in the text and edges represent relations between them. This is an entity-centric approach rather than an event-centric approach, where the temporal axis and relations between events are backgrounded to prioritize a view of entities and their relations. Since [ 2 ] , the approach has been applied in various settings and with different types of relations [ 10 ] . In this work, we use a co-occurrence graph: nodes are entities and an edge between two entities indicates that they co-occur within a limited text span.
blocks.zh: 叙述图将文本建模为一个网络,其中节点代表文本中提到的实体,边缘代表它们之间的关系. 这是一种以实体为中心的办法,而不是以事件为中心的办法,即以时间轴和事件之间的关系为背景,优先看待实体及其关系。 自[2]起,该办法适用于各种环境并具有不同类型的关系[10]。 在这项工作中,我们使用一个并发图:节点是实体,两个实体之间的边缘表示它们在有限的文本跨度内共发.

blocks.en: 2.1 Graph construction
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 图表构造

blocks.en: We create a narrative graph from a text collection in three steps. The analytical focus is on PMI weighting and community detection rather than on sophisticated entity extraction, and the pipeline is kept accordingly simple. Coreference resolution is included as the linguistically principled default for entity-centric analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们用三个步骤从文本集中创建一个叙事图. 分析重点是PMI加权和社区检测,而不是精密的实体提取,因此管道保持了简单. 参照分辨率被列为以实体为中心的分析在语言上原则性的缺省。

blocks.en: We use a SpaCy pipeline [ 8 ] augmented with coreference resolution via fastcoref [ 12 ] to extract entities in a broad sense — characters, locations, objects, and concepts. Coreference resolution links mentions to their antecedents, so that pronouns and other anaphoric expressions are captured as occurrences of the entities they refer to. Named Entity Recognition targets character names and locations; Noun Phrase Chunking extends coverage to objects and concepts. To limit generic nouns, noun phrases must consist of at least two tokens.
blocks.zh: 我们利用一个SpaCy管道[8],通过快分f[12]的同位素分辨率加以扩充,以提取广义的实体——人物、地点、物体和概念。 共参考解析链接提到它们的前作,从而将代名词和其他动词表达作为它们所指的实体的发生来捕捉. 命名的实体识别目标字符名和位置;名词词春金将覆盖范围扩展到对象和概念. 为了限制通用名词,名词短语必须至少由两个符号组成.

blocks.en: Extracted entities are resolved through two heuristic steps. First, entities are mapped to a canonical form via lemmatization. Second, supergrams are mapped to their shortest subgram (such as the dark lord Sauron to the dark lord ), provided the subgram is at least twice as frequent and at least two tokens long. These conditions balance resolving different mentions of the same entity against retaining weak signals from the rare entities that we target. Beyond resolution, we apply minimal filtering: single-occurrence entities are removed as likely extraction noise, but otherwise the foregrounding of meaningful entities is left to the subsequent community detection step.
blocks.zh: 被提取的实体通过两个高压步骤解决。 首先,实体通过闪光化被映射成犬科。 其次,超克被映射到它们最短的子克上(如暗黑的领主Sauron到暗黑领主),只要子克的频率至少是2倍,并至少有2个符号长. 这些条件既解决了对同一实体的不同提法,又解决了保留我们所瞄准的稀有实体的微弱信号的问题。 在分辨率之外,我们采用最小的过滤法:将单发实体作为可能的取出噪声去除,但否则,有意义的实体的前置权留给随后的社区检测步骤.

blocks.en: Co-occurrences are extracted using a sliding window of three sentences. Each pair of entities appearing within the same window is counted as one co-occurrence.
blocks.zh: 并发取出取出用相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 在同一窗口内出现的每对实体均被计算为一个共犯。

blocks.en: 2.2 PMI-weighted edges
blocks.zh: 2.2 PMI加权边

blocks.en: PMI is calculated for two entities A A and B B as in [ 4 ] : P ​ M ​ I ​ ( A , B ) = log ⁡ P ⁡ ( A , B ) P ⁡ ( A ) ​ P ​ ( B ) PMI(A,B)=\log\frac{P(A,B)}{P(A)P(B)}
blocks.zh: 对两个实体A和B的PMI的计算如下: [4] :PM I(A,B) = log → P (A,B) → P (A,B) → PMI (A,B) → log\frac{ P(A,B) → P(A,B) → P(A,B)}

blocks.en: Entity occurrence probabilities are obtained through maximum likelihood estimation from corpus frequencies: P ⁡ ( A ) = f ⁡ ( A ) / N P(A)=f(A)/N where N N is the total number of entity mentions. Their joint probabilities are estimated by counting the number of times that A A and B B both appear in the co-occurrence window described above: P ⁡ ( A , B ) = f ⁡ ( A , B ) / N P(A,B)=f(A,B)/N . A positive PMI indicates that two entities co-occur more than expected by chance; a negative PMI indicates the opposite.
blocks.zh: 实体发生概率是通过对实体频率的最大概率估计得到的:P → (A) = f → (A) / N P (A) = f (A) / N N N N 是指N 是指实体的总数. 它们的联想概率是通过计算A和B同时出现在上述联想窗口中的次数来估计: P → (A, B) = f → (A, B) / N P (A, B) = f (A, B)/ N. PMI呈正值,表明两个实体的协同率高于偶然预期;PMI呈负值,表明相反。

blocks.en: PMI has a known tendency to inflate for rare events: if two entities are individually rare, even a single co-occurrence can yield a high PMI value. This is typically considered a limitation; [ 4 ] note that the measure becomes unstable below a frequency of 5. For our purposes, however, this property is central. The inflation foregrounds precisely the rare entity pairs that form the basis of the peripheral structures. Figure 1 illustrates this with a heatmap of mean PMI by entity frequency brackets in The Lord of the Rings . Low-frequency entity pairs have considerably higher PMI than high-frequency ones.
blocks.zh: PMI有已知的为罕见事件膨胀的倾向:如果两个实体单独是罕见的,即使一个并发也可以产生高PMI值. 这通常被认为是一种限制;[4]指出该措施在5个频率以下变得不稳定. 然而,对于我们来说,这种财产是核心的。 通货膨胀的预测正是形成外围结构基础的稀有实体对. 图1按环王中的实体频率括号显示平均PMI的热图。 低频实体对的PMI比高频对多得多.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Mean PMI by entity frequency in The Lord of the Rings . Pairs with low frequency entities generally have a much higher PMI than pairs with high frequency entities.
blocks.zh: 图1:环王中按实体频率分列的平均PMI。 有低频实体的对等一般比有高频实体的对等高得多的PMI.

blocks.en: 2.3 Community detection
blocks.zh: 2.3 社区检测

blocks.en: Given a PMI-weighted graph that foregrounds connections between rare entities, we employ community detection to identify tightly connected subgraphs as candidates. We compare two methods that differ in two key properties: whether they allow overlapping communities, and whether PMI is treated as continuous weights or used for filtering. Both are applied using their implementations in the NetworkX package [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个PMI加权图预示着稀有实体之间的联系,我们利用社区检测来识别紧密相通的子图为候选. 我们比较了两种在两个关键属性上不同的方法:它们是否允许重叠群落,以及PMI是被当作连续加权处理还是用于过滤. 两者均采用在NetworkX软件包[6]中的执行.

blocks.en: The Louvain community detection algorithm [ 3 ] is a hierarchical method that iteratively merges communities while optimizing for modularity. It partitions the graph: each entity belongs to exactly one community. In a narrative setting, this is a strong constraint, as entities naturally participate in multiple narrative configurations. On the other hand, Louvain supports continuous edge weights, operating directly on the PMI-weighted graph without requiring a threshold. Its key hyperparameter, resolution , controls community granularity.
blocks.zh: Louvain社区检测算法[3]是一种分级方法,可以迭代地将社区合并,同时优化模块化. 它分割了图表:每个实体完全属于一个社区。 在叙事环境中,这是一个很强的制约因素,因为实体自然参与多种叙事配置. 另一方面,卢万支持连续边重,直接在PMI加权图上运行而不需要阈值. 其关键超参数,分辨率,控制了社区颗粒.

blocks.en: In k-clique percolation, a community is defined as "a union of all k -cliques (complete subgraphs of size k k ) that can be reached from each other through a series of adjacent k -cliques (where adjacency means sharing k − 1 k-1 nodes)" [ 13 , 815] . Crucially, the method allows communities to overlap, reflecting the narrative reality that characters and locations participate in more than one subplot. The method has two hyperparameters: k k , the minimum clique size, and a weight threshold w w that filters edges below a given PMI value. The weight threshold interacts with PMI weighting: filtering by w w removes weaker, more frequent connections, retaining the strong associations between rare entities.
blocks.zh: 在k-clique percoloration中,一个社区被定义为"由所有k-cliques(大小为kk的完整子图)组成的一个联盟,通过一系列相邻的k-cliques(其中相邻指共享k-一k-1节点)可以相互达到"[13,815]. 关键是,该方法允许社区重叠,反映了人物和地点参与一个以上子绘图的叙事现实. 该方法有两个超参数:k k,最小的会合体大小;和一个重阈值w w,过滤出一个给定的PMI值以下的边缘. 重量阈值与PMI加权相互作用:由ww过滤去除较弱,更频繁的连接,保留了稀有实体之间的强关联.

blocks.en: 2.4 Measures of textual confinement
blocks.zh: 2.4 文字禁闭措施

blocks.en: A community can be activated at certain points over the course of a text. An activation means that some of the entities of a community co-occur within a text passage — the same co-occurrences that back the edges of the graph. We refer to a document that contains at least one such activation for a given community as a spike . For The Lord of the Rings , we take sections delimited by double line breaks as documents.
blocks.zh: 在文本过程中,一个社区可以在一定的点上被激活. 活化指一个社区的一些实体在一个文本段落中共同存在——与图边后部相同的共同发生. 我们提到一个文件,其中至少包含一个针对特定社区的这种激活,作为高峰。 对魔戒之王来说,我们把被双行断开划分的部分作为文件。

blocks.en: Given an ordering of documents, we characterize a community by the spread of its spikes: the distance from first to last activation, measured in documents. A community with all its spikes in consecutive or near-consecutive documents has low spread; one whose spikes are separated by long stretches of text has high spread. Note that the number of spikes is bounded by spread: a community cannot be activated in more documents than it spans, so the space of possible configurations is triangular rather than rectangular.
blocks.zh: 鉴于文件的订购,我们以文件所显示的从第一次激活到最后一次激活的距离为特征。 连续或接近相交文件的尖锐化的社区分布率低;一个其尖锐化被长长的文本隔开的社区分布率高. 注意:指针的数量被分布所限制:一个群落无法被比所跨多的文档所激活,因此可能配置的空间是三角而不是长方形.

blocks.en: We use three reference points within this space to orient our qualitative analysis (Figure 2 ): episodic (concentrated activations within a limited span), echoing (few activations at distant points), and recurring (multiple activations spread across the text). These are prototypes in a continuous space rather than clear-cut categories. What they correspond to in terms of narrative function is an empirical question that we address in the analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们在这个空间内使用三个参考点来引导我们的质量分析(图2):偶发性(集中在有限时间内的活化),回放性(遥远点的活化)和反复性(多活化分散在文本中)。 这些原型是一个连续空间,而不是明确的类别。 就叙述功能而言,它们对应的是我们在分析中处理的一个经验问题。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Conceptual illustration of the three prototypical peripheral structures. Spikes (vertical lines) represent documents where part of a community is activated. The horizontal axis represents the sequential or temporal ordering of documents. (a) Episodic structures have concentrated activations within a limited span. (b) Echoing structures have few activations at distant points. (c) Recurring structures have multiple activations spread across the text.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 三个典型外围结构的概念说明。 Spikes(垂直行)代表一个社区的一部分被激活的文档. 横向轴代表文件的顺序或时间顺序。 (a) 偶发性结构在有限的时间内集中激活。 (b) 回声结构在遥远点的活化作用很少。 (c) 反复出现的结构具有分散在案文中的多重活性。

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Comparison of community detection algorithms
blocks.zh: 3.1 社区检测算法比较

blocks.en: The two methods can produce quite different communities depending on hyperparameter settings. We selected hyperparameters that yield comparable community sizes: k = 4 k=4 and w = 2 w=2 for k-clique percolation and r ​ e ​ s ​ o ​ l ​ u ​ t ​ i ​ o ​ n = 35 resolution=35 for Louvain. As noted by [ 13 ] , k-cliques often result in at least one dominant community that is considerably bigger than the rest. We also observed these and discard them from the analysis. Descriptive statistics are presented in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 根据超参数设置,这两种方法可以产生相当不同的社区. 我们选择了可产生可比群落大小的超参数:k=4克=4克和w=2个w=2个k-clique percoloration,r e s o l u i o n = 35个分辨率为Louvain. 正如[13]所指出,k-cliques往往导致至少一个占支配地位的社区比其他社区大得多。 我们还观察到这些,并从分析中丢弃。 描述性统计数字见表1。

blocks.en: Table 1: Descriptive statistics of the number and sizes of communities extracted from The Lord of the Rings
blocks.zh: 表1:从环王手中提取的社区数量和规模的描述性统计

blocks.en: At comparable community sizes, k-clique produces considerable more communities than Louvain. This is expected because k-clique allows overlapping communities, meaning that the same entities can appear in multiple communities. On average, an entity belongs to 1.9 k-clique communities.
blocks.zh: 在相似的社区规模中,k-clique产生的社区远远多于卢万。 这是因为k-clique允许重叠社区,意味着同一个实体可以在多个社区中出现. 平均来说,一个实体属于1.9克-社区。

blocks.en: From manual inspection, both methods produce communities that correspond to recognizable narrative elements. However, both also exhibit a shared characteristic: the extracted communities are often fragments of a broader narrative configuration. Consider the following community: Community a faint hiss, deep shade, black holes, the shapes Context So black were they that they seemed like black holes in the deep shade behind them. Frodo thought that he heard a faint hiss as of venomous breath and felt a thin piercing chill. Then the shapes slowly advanced. Terror overcame Pippin and Merry, and they threw themselves flat on the ground. Sam shrank to Frodo’s side.
blocks.zh: 通过人工检查,这两种方法都产生了与可识别的叙述要素相适应的社区。 然而,两者也都显示出一个共同的特征:被取出的社区往往是更广泛的叙事结构的碎片. 想想下面的社区: 社区是一个昏暗的他, 深荫,黑洞, 形状,背景 佛罗多认为他听到一阵晕倒,像毒气般的呼吸,并感到一股薄薄的穿孔寒冷. 然后形状慢慢地发展. 恐怖战胜了皮平和梅里 他们把自己扔到地上 Sam 向佛罗多一边收缩。

blocks.en: The passage is, in short, a part of the events that unfold at Weathertop where the Ringwraiths pursue, find and approach the four hobbits. The entities in the community pertain to the description of the Ringwraiths. Not all entities involved in the scene constitute the community, but a coherent subset of them does. This emphasizes how the community structure reflects a peripheral element of a narrative rather than fully constituting it.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,这个通道是Weathertop上发生的事件的一部分,在那里,Ringwraits追寻,找到并接近了四个霍比特人. 社区中的实体与Ringwraith的描述有关。 并非所有参与现场活动的实体都构成社区,但其中一部分是统一的。 这强调了社区结构如何反映叙述的外围因素,而不是完全构成叙述。

blocks.en: Given comparable quality, we adopt k-clique percolation as the primary method, but the reported findings generally hold for Louvain communities as well. K-clique’s allowance of overlapping communities better reflects the narrative reality that characters and locations participate in more than one configuration. That it produces many more communities at comparable sizes is a consequence of this property.
blocks.zh: 由于质量相当,我们采用k-clique穿孔法作为主要方法,但所报告的调查结果一般也适用于卢万社区。 K-clique对重叠社区的允许性更好地反映了描述现实,即人物和地点参与一个以上的配置。 这种财产的后果是,它产生了更多规模相当的社区。

blocks.en: 3.2 Typology
blocks.zh: 3.2 类型

blocks.en: Running k-clique percolation on the PMI-weighted narrative network of The Lord of the Rings yields 1193 communities. Roughly three quarters are single-spike communities, activated in only one section, and therefore fall under the episodic type. Of the remaining multi-spike quarter, roughly a quarter are episodic (with multiple spikes in close proximity), roughly half are echoing, and the last quarter are recurring. Representative examples of all types as well as their subtypes can be seen in Table 2 .

blocks.en: Episodic structures are concentrated activations within a limited span. These are generally idiosyncratic in terms of entities which is expected from an information-theoretic perspective. Rare entities co-occur with few others, and small clusters in proximity will surface as communities with high internal PMI. What they correspond to varies: short descriptions, events, songs, or fragments of dialogue. As we saw with the example in the previous section, they can be interwoven with or themselves interweave other sub-narratives. A subset of episodic structures are sustained across multiple consecutive sections, e.g., concentrated sub-plots or scenic descriptions. These are few but distinct, and the more sustained they are, the less they are favored by PMI, since their entities will be more frequent.
blocks.zh: 活化结构是有限时间内的集中活化. 从信息理论的角度来看,这些实体通常具有特殊性。 少数实体与少数其他实体并存,邻近的小型集群将作为社区表面,具有较高的内部PMI。 它们对应的内容各不相同:简短的描述、事件、歌曲或对话的片段。 正如我们在上一节中看到的例子,它们可以与其他子描述相互交织或相互交织. 一个子集的偶发结构在多个相接地段之间被维持,例如集中地分地或景色描述. 这些机构很少,但各不相同,而且越是持久,就越没有受到私营军事和海事机构的支持,因为其实体将更加频繁。

blocks.en: Echoing structures (roughly a quarter) form a distinct class in which an idiosyncratic configuration reappears at a distant point in the text: a poem or song revisited, an event or quote repeated or referenced, or a specific (lore) reference between two or few entities. These long-distance connections are particularly interesting in a hybrid close-distant reading setting, where the computational method surfaces connections that a human reader may struggle to pick up across hundreds of pages. Below is an example where a vision by Sam in the Mirror of Galadriel in book one is realized by the end of book two.
blocks.zh: 回声结构(大约四分之一)形成一个独特的类,其中一种特异性配置在文本中一个遥远的地方再现:一首诗或一首歌被重温,一出事件或引文被重复或引用,或两个或几个实体之间具体的(略)引用. 这些长途连接在混合式近距离读取设置中特别有趣,在这种设置中,计算方法会浮出人类读者可能难以从上百页取取的连接. 下面是一个例子,在第二本书结尾处实现一书"加拉德里尔之镜"中山姆的一幅视觉.

blocks.en: Recurring structures span much of the work and show internal variation. A small tail of many-spiked communities tends to be diluted by generic nouns, such as pairs like left side and right side that co-occur frequently but are questionable as meaningful narrative elements, or by aggregated connections between entities that do not form a meaningful cluster. Among the meaningful communities, some function as lore threads reflecting recurring geographic or world-building references, others track recurring sub-plots across distant parts of the narrative, and a third pattern emerges where a later passage gathers threads dispersed across earlier sections into a retrospective account.
blocks.zh: 经常发生的结构贯穿了大部分工作,并显示出内部差异。 由被多溅成的群落组成的小尾巴往往被一般名词所稀释,如相邻的左侧和右侧等对子经常被同化,但作为有意义的叙事要素却值得怀疑,或者通过不形成有意义的集群的实体之间的综合联系被稀释. 在有意义的社区中,有些是反映反复出现的地理或世界建设参考文献的线条,另一些是追踪叙述中遥远部分反复出现的子地块,第三种模式是,后一段将分散在前几段的线条汇集成回顾性叙述。

blocks.en: 4 Discussion and future work
blocks.zh: 4. 讨论和今后的工作

blocks.en: The central idea of our work is to enhance weak signals by treating the statistical properties that make rare entities unreliable in conventional analyses as a resource rather than a nuisance. The approach is conceptually simple: weight a narrative network with PMI, extract communities from it, and characterize the output by simple structural measures. PMI amplifies rare co-occurrences, and community detection organizes those amplified signals into interpretable clusters. Whether or not every resulting community is meaningful, the principle — that structure exists in the long tail and can be made visible through deliberate amplification — is, we believe, broadly applicable beyond the present setting.
blocks.zh: 我们工作的核心思想是通过把在常规分析中使稀有实体不可靠的统计属性视为一种资源而不是一种烦恼来增强弱信号。 这种方法在概念上很简单:用PMI来权衡一个叙事网络,从中取出社区,并以简单的结构度量法来定性产出. PMI放大了罕见的并发现象,社区检测将那些被放大的信号组织成可解释的集群. 不论由此产生的每个社区是否都有意义,这一原则——即结构存在于长尾部,并且能够通过蓄意扩大而明显可见——我们认为,在目前情况下之外广泛适用。

blocks.en: The typology that emerges from characterizing the extracted communities by their spikes and spread reveals that peripheral narrative structures form more than a single class. The bulk are single-spike communities from idiosyncratic passages that are introduced and wrapped up within a single section. One might question their value in a macro-perspective, but their sheer prevalence may hint at structural properties of narrative, namely that stories constantly introduce and resolve small elements alongside their central progression. The multi-spike communities, in turn, reveal how peripheral elements can also echo or recur across a narrative. This is particularly notable in how they surface weak-signal connections between elements across long textual distances. Such connections are easy to overlook and invisible to computational methods that foreground salience.
blocks.zh: 以被抽取的社区为特征的分型和分型表明,边缘叙事结构不仅仅是一个阶层。 大部分是来自特异性通道的单斯皮克社区,这些通道被引入并被包裹在一个单段内. 人们可能会在宏观角度质疑它们的价值,但是它们本身的普遍性可能暗示着叙述的结构性性质,即故事在中心进展的同时不断引入和解决小要素。 反过来,多配偶社区揭示外围因素如何在叙述中相互呼应或重复。 这一点尤其显著,因为它们在较长的文字距离上,在元素之间显示出微弱的信号联系。 这种联系很容易被忽略,在预想突出的计算方法中是看不见的。

blocks.en: More broadly, the method can be regarded as a facilitator of further analysis. It does not replace interpretive work. The extracted communities are candidates, often even fragmentary ones, not conclusions. But it surfaces specific entity configurations, and these trace back to passages that can then be examined. This aligns with an idea of complementary contributions of computational and traditional literary analysis, where quantitative methods help recognize and surface patterns at scale [ 11 , 9 ] . The long tail of rare entities can at first appear as an unstructured mass, but our method recovers non-random structures within it.
blocks.zh: 更广泛地说,该方法可被视为进一步分析的促进者。 它不能取代解释性工作。 被抽取的社区是候选社区,甚至往往是零碎的社区,而不是结论。 但是,它表面呈现出特定的实体配置,这些可追溯到可以检查的段落. 这与计算和传统文学分析的互补贡献概念是一致的,其中定量方法有助于识别并显示规模规律[11,9]. 稀有实体的长尾可起先以无结构的质量出现,但我们的方法恢复了其中的非随机结构.

blocks.en: The described method deliberately leverages the instability of PMI at low frequencies [ 4 ] , which is a direct consequence of the unreliability of MLE probability estimates for rare events [ 1 , 5 ] . The extracted communities depend on PMI values, which depend on marginal and joint probability estimates, which depend on entity counts. Operating in low-frequency territory, even small differences in individual entity counts propagate through each of these steps. This makes the method highly susceptible to extraction errors: at the level of rare entities, a single false positive or negative can distort PMI associations drastically, unlike macro-level patterns where signal strength masks such errors. Similarly, any changes to count input, such as coreference resolution or different entity resolution strategies, affect PMI values considerably. The method is also sensitive to hyperparameter choices. k k and the weight threshold for k-clique percolation can shift individual community assignments, though we observed that some communities are more stable under such variation than others — an observation worth formalizing in future work. This inescapable sensitivity illustrates that the method is best understood as a bottom-up lens for surfacing structure in the long tail of rare entities, rather than a robust pipeline for extracting predefined latent structures.
blocks.zh: 被描述的方法故意利用低频率[4]PMI的不稳定性,这是罕见事件MLE概率估计值不可靠所直接造成的. [1,5]. 被取出的社区依赖于PMI值,这取决于边际和共同概率估计,这取决于实体的计数. 在低频地区运作,甚至个别实体的微小差异通过这些步骤传播。 这使得该方法极易被提取出错误:在稀有实体的层面上,一个单一的假正或负可以急剧地扭曲PMI关联,与信号强度掩盖了这种错误的宏观模式不同. 同样,对输入进行计数的任何改变,如coference分辨率或不同的实体分辨率策略,都会对PMI值产生重大影响. 这种方法对超参数选择也十分敏感. kk和k-clique穿孔的重量阈值可以改变各个社区的任务,尽管我们观察到,有些社区在这种变化下比其他社区更稳定——这一观察值得在今后的工作中正式确定。 这种不可回避的敏感性说明,这种方法最好被理解为稀有实体的长尾部表面结构的自下而上透镜,而不是提取预先定义的潜在结构的活泼管道.

blocks.en: On the methodological side, other association measures such as log-likelihood [ 5 ] , which is more robust at low frequencies, may complement or improve the approach, and community detection algorithms that handle overlap differently offer a natural point of comparison. Empirically, application to other literary works and registers is a natural extension: more minimalist works with fewer characters or sparser descriptions may yield different results, and whether this reflects fewer peripheral structures or a different relationship between peripheral and central elements remains open. The structures recovered here are also characterized bottom-up; stronger grounding in narrative theory [ 14 ] would complement that.
blocks.zh: 在方法方面,其他关联措施,如在低频率时更强健的log-likelihood [5],可能补充或改进该方法,处理不同重叠的群落检测算法提供自然的比较点. 经验性地说,应用到其他文学作品和登记册是自然的延伸:比较最小化的作品,人物较少或描述比较少,可能会产生不同的结果,无论这反映的外围结构较少,还是外围和中心元素之间的不同关系,都仍然开放. 这里恢复的结构也具有自下而上的特点;在叙事理论中加强基础[14]将补充这一点。

blocks.en: We have demonstrated that quantitative methods need not favor only salient signals. By treating PMI’s inflation for rare events as a strength rather than a weakness and applying community detection, we surface non-random structure among rare entities — peripheral structures that trace back to recognizable parts of the source text, and that can otherwise be lost in abundance.
blocks.zh: 我们已经表明,定量方法不只需要偏好突出的信号。 通过将PMI对稀有事件的通胀作为力量而非弱点来看待,并应用社区检测,我们从稀有实体中表面呈现出非随机结构——外围结构可以追溯到源文本的可识别部分,否则会大量丢失.
